shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -la && ls -R .agents .claude | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -30 package-lock.json

ls -R src __agent_eval__; for f in src/* index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "form|uikit" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40

node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').peerDependenciesMeta)"; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Card Text ThemeProvider Flex 2>&1 | head -80
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Card Text ThemeProvider Flex 2>&1 | head -80
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; echo ====; rg -n -i -A12 "required setup|## Usage|getting started" README.md | head -80
sed -n 120,400p INDEX.md | rg -n -i "provider|theme|flex|box|form|field"; ls components components/controls hooks | head -100
rg -n -C3 "Provider" guides/theming.md | head -70; echo ====I18N; rg -n -C3 "lang|configure" guides/i18n-ru.md | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components && rg -n "^#|^\| *\`?[a-zA-Z]+\`? *\|" controls/TextInput.md controls/PasswordInput.md Checkbox.md | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && rg -n "^\| *(type|width|loading|view|size|disabled|as|variant|color|theme|gap|direction|spacing|children)\b" components/Button.md components/Card.md components/Text.md components/Alert.md; echo ===; rg -n "header-|subheader|display-|body-" guides/typography.md | head -30; echo ===; rg -n -C3 "gap|direction" guides/layout.md | head -60

sed -n 53,84p rules/hallucination-traps.md; sed -n 150,175p rules/hallucination-traps.md; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && rg -n "spacing|direction|alignItems|justifyContent" docs/guides/layout.md | sed -n 1,40p

f=$(find . -path '*layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts' | head -1); echo $f; cat $f | head -60; b=$(find . -path '*layout/Box/Box.d.ts' -o -path '*layout/Box/types.d.ts' | head -3); echo $b; rg -n "padding|maxWidth|width\b|direction|gap" $(dirname $f)/../ -g '*.d.ts' | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,40p Text/Text.d.ts | rg -n "interface|extends|as|Props" ; rg -n "type CardType|CardView|CardTheme|interface CardProps|className" Card/Card.d.ts | head; rg -n "ButtonView =|type\?" Button/*.d.ts | head
rm -rf dist && grep -n gravity package.json && git status --short
